meta.name: Kairo Design Tokens
meta.principle: Calm, neutral, Swiss-inspired visual language (Müller-Brockmann lineage): neutral-dominated surfaces, 4px spacing rhythm, precise typographic hierarchy, restrained motion. Meaning is never carried by colour alone.
meta.note: Conceptual tokens are platform-neutral. Concrete rendering values may differ slightly per platform (Material 3 vs Bootstrap/SCSS); each platform keeps its verified rendering. Both platforms must use the same semantic names, scales and meanings.

brand.meaning: Primary interactive colour: buttons, links, focus, active navigation. Tenant branding may override at runtime.

surface.meaning: Neutral ladder for backgrounds, cards, borders and text. Cool-neutral tint keeps the calm tone.

positive.meaning: Completed, paid, active, healthy. Never the only signal — always paired with an icon or label.

attention.meaning: Pending, open, due soon, needs review. Requires an action or a wait.

critical.meaning: Overdue, suspended, failed, destructive. Also the colour of destructive actions.

info.meaning: Neutral guidance, informational state, in-progress without risk.

accent.meaning: Secondary highlight, sparse use only (charts, focus rings).

space.meaning: 4px baseline rhythm. Every margin, padding and gap is a multiple of the scale; no ad-hoc values.

radius.meaning: Three shape roles: small for compact controls, medium for cards/inputs, large for sheets and hero surfaces.

typography.meaning: Hierarchy through size, weight and spacing — never colour alone. Sans for UI, mono for codes and identifiers.

mono.use: member codes, identifiers, amounts in tables

typography.bindingNote: Vue renders these through .om-text-* classes; Flutter through the Material 3 TextTheme in app_theme.dart.

motion.meaning: Motion confirms cause and effect; it never decorates. Honour reduced-motion preferences.
motion.easing: emphasised ease-out (cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) on Web; Curves.easeOutCubic on Flutter)

touchTarget.meaning: WCAG 2.2 target size. Interactive controls are at least 44x44 CSS px including padding; icon-only controls must not shrink below it.
touchTarget.vue: enforced via button padding and .om-touch-min utility
touchTarget.flutter: enforced via constraints in shared components (app_feedback, app_status_badge, navigation)

breakpoints.meaning: Content reflows by width band. The 320px band must never overflow destructively.
breakpoints.vue: Bootstrap grid (576/768/992/1200) with the documented 4/6/12 column layout
breakpoints.flutter: LayoutBuilder phone layout (<600) and desktop/web layout (>=600), golden-verified at 390x844 and 1280x900

elevation.meaning: Minimal shadow use (Swiss principle). Surfaces separate mostly through border and spacing.
elevation.flutter: Material 3 elevation via surface tint and border (see AppSurfaceCard)
